pickups.ask: The attendant's security card, clipped to what's left of his belt. Take it?
An INK RIBBON on the security desk. Take it?
A herb in a pot by the bench. Take it?

text: The attendant's booth. The glass is cracked from the inside.
He got out. He didn't get far.
A car rammed into the pillar. The driver's seat is empty and slick.
OUT OF SERVICE. Carl said the shafts aren't safe.
Twenty-four floors. Stairs.
A directory. Two towers joined by a walkway on the 24th floor.
LAB, 28F, TOWER B, circled in pen.
The stairwell door. A card reader blinks red.

say: Fluorescent light, wet concrete, and a smell like a butcher's.
The bite on his hand has gone black at the edges. It throbs in time with his heart.

text: Hello? Hello! Is anybody up there?
...Who is this? How did you get into the car park?
I've got a delivery. B7. A guy named Paul said to bring it to the lab.
B7? You have it? Oh my God. Okay. Okay. My name is Carl. Listen very carefully.
Don't use the elevators. The shafts aren't safe, something is living in them.
Take the stairs to twenty-four. Cross the walkway to Tower B. Then up to twenty-eight.
We'll be waiting for you.
Twenty-four floors.
I'm sorry. Please hurry.

say: Bryan sits on the bench and takes out his phone. No signal. He hits record anyway.

text: Hey. Michelle. It's me. Again. I don't know if you'll ever see this.
I'm okay. That's a lie, I'm not okay. Something bit me and my hand looks... bad.
I have to take this thing upstairs. Twenty-four floors. They say it'll help. Stop this.
I love you. I should've said it more. I'm gonna say it so much when I get home.
Okay. Bye.
The reader blinks green. Beyond the fire door, a stairwell climbs into the dark.
B2. B1. 1. 2. Twenty-two more to go.
